description: Canonical machine contract for RedDirt Cursor self-build slices. Future packets must be expressible as JSON objects conforming to sliceObjectRequiredKeys and validationRules.
globalSafetyRules: Declare allowedPaths, forbiddenPaths, allowedReads, and allowedWrites before editing; stay inside them.
Treat globalForbiddenActions as hard stops unless a steered production_proof packet explicitly lists a governed exception and human gates.
Every slice lists proofRequired and checksRequired; run listed checks and record redacted outputs or logs paths only—never paste secrets.
v2Layers must only use keys from data/architecture/reddirt_v2_layer_registry.json (allowedV2LayerKeys).
Database_migration and production_proof slices require humanApprovalGates and rollbackNotes with concrete revert guidance.
Cross-lane work (sos-public, ajax, phatlip, countyWorkbench) requires Steve-approved integration packets; default is forbid.
Local green (npm run check, typecheck) does not upgrade hosted_ready or operator_proven without environment-specific proof artifacts.
AI outputs are advisory until merged through the same review path as any other change.

validationRules.message: Slice object is missing one or more required keys from requiredSliceFields.
sliceId must be a non-empty string (prefer UPPER-SNAKE packet id with version, e.g. REDDIRT-EXAMPLE-1.0).
sliceType must be one of allowedSliceTypes.
Each v2Layers entry must be a registry layer key from allowedV2LayerKeys (empty array allowed only for pure selfbuild/documentation slices that explicitly state no layer touch in governanceRules).
allowedPaths, forbiddenPaths, allowedReads, allowedWrites must be arrays of strings.
Listed fields must be arrays of strings.
allowedPaths is empty while sliceType implies code or runtime touch; confirm scope is intentional.
allowedWrites must not explicitly authorize global forbidden actions; use human-governed production_proof packets instead.
Completion report object is missing one or more keys from requiredReportFields (see reddirt_selfbuild_required_return_format.json).

sliceObjectContract.title: Human-readable title.
sliceObjectContract.v2Layers: Registry layer keys touched; subset of allowedV2LayerKeys.
sliceObjectContract.whyNow: Why this slice is queued now (dependency / risk / unlock).
sliceObjectContract.allowedPaths: Glob or prefix paths under RedDirt/ that may be read for context (and written if also in allowedWrites).
sliceObjectContract.allowedReads: Narrow reads (docs, data JSON, env variable names without values).
sliceObjectContract.allowedWrites: Explicit write scope; must not broaden into forbidden siblings or secrets.
sliceObjectContract.requiredInputs: Artifacts, env presence flags, tickets—no secret values.
sliceObjectContract.expectedOutputs: Files, behaviors, or proofs this slice must produce.
sliceObjectContract.proofRequired: Evidence types (CLI names, screenshots policy, operator sign-off).
sliceObjectContract.checksRequired: Commands or human checks; outputs referenced without secrets.
sliceObjectContract.progressEffects: What ledger, registry, or readiness state may advance if proofs pass.
sliceObjectContract.governanceRules: Packet-specific rules layered on top of globalSafetyRules.
sliceObjectContract.humanApprovalGates: Named humans or roles required before merge or execution.
sliceObjectContract.rollbackNotes: How to revert or neutralize partial work.
sliceObjectContract.finalReturnFormat: Ordered list of report section keys (from requiredReportFields) this slice expects in the handoff; may repeat docs/PROTO conventions.
